description: NVFP4-CB / FP8-CB codebook container, served by the out-of-tree gridbook plugin (plugins/gridbook/). Same OpenAI endpoint as the native lane — which is exactly why the CB half of R16 is wiring, not capability: validate_quantized_model is already endpoint-agnostic and knows nothing about the container.

gates.description: CB artifacts load ONLY through the gridbook plugin, so the load+generate smoke runs in the plugin's serving env, not in the build venv. The gridbook cb_fill_guard raises from process_weights_after_loading if any CB expert tensor went unconsumed (D3) — the failure mode this gate exists for is coherent-looking garbage, not a crash.
Unchanged from the native lane: same script, same endpoint, same thresholds.
Served KL-vs-BF16 in the plugin serving env. Match extension residency across A/B arms: loading a CUDA extension shifts allocator addresses and moves confident-KL by up to 17%.
Direct WikiText PPL on the served CB artifact.

INV-2: no rung is production-eligible until it clears the prefill perf gate as well as the quality gate — a Triton-masquerade fallback that serves correct tokens slowly is a failed lane, not a passed one.

kl_evaluator.note: Reachable on this lane since CB Milestone C (R3): the production cache renders CB rungs imatrix-weighted via --col-weights, so a frontier KL measures the bytes the exporter ships. Selection on this lane is still SURROGATE by default — validated-frontier CB selection is enabled, not promoted.

notes: Four archs are declared CB-eligible (qwen3_5, qwen3_5_dense, hy_v3, laguna); the preflight refuses anything else (R6).
Single-GPU only: no TP path in the plugin.
